expert-team.selection_help: Choose up to 16 actual tasks in the loaded list. Each task keeps its own tests and independent human acceptance.
expert-team.configuration_intro: Bind this team's actual project resources to reviewed workflows, tools and knowledge. Team membership and expert labels do not grant additional authority.
expert-team.draft_notice: Saving creates a draft and invalidates unstarted previews from the previous configuration. Publish separately after reviewing the role bindings.
expert-team.resource: Actual team agent or tool resource
expert-team.choose_resource: Choose a project resource in this team
expert-team.no_resources: No active agent or tool resource from this project is registered in the team. Add a real project resource and its team membership first. Human task ownership is managed separately.
expert-team.choose_workflow: Choose a workflow with independent candidate testing
expert-team.role_key_hint: Use a lowercase letter first, followed by letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Keep this key stable when updating a responsibility.
expert-team.publication_notice: Publish these fixed role bindings for new previews. Publication does not start tasks or grant tool, machine or pool permissions.
expert-team.retirement_notice: Retirement blocks new previews and cannot be reversed. Existing runs retain their original workflows and evidence.
expert-team.historical: Historical snapshot, not current execution authority
expert-team.configuration_saved: Operation confirmed. Reading the current configuration.
expert-team.recovery_hint: Recover the same saved request before changing the configuration. Its original project, team, role bindings and operation key are retained.
expert-team.invalid_read: The expert team response does not match the current project or expected contract.
expert-team.refresh_failed: Current facts could not be refreshed. Your role inputs are retained.
expert-team.access_changed: Current authority no longer permits this operation. Reload the current view.
expert-team.knowledge_limit: A role can bind at most 8 distinct reviewed knowledge entries.
expert-team.dispatch_intro: Review one fixed team configuration and one role per selected task. A single confirmation starts the complete batch atomically.
expert-team.selection_invalid: Select 1–16 distinct, unaccepted tasks from the current project's loaded list. No tasks are silently added or omitted.
expert-team.choose_team: Choose an eligible published team configuration
expert-team.no_configuration: No eligible published configuration is in the loaded page. Configure and review this project's team roles first, or load more.
expert-team.preview_notice: Preparing a preview does not create runs or change task owners. The server fixes each task, requirement, design, knowledge and execution route for review.
expert-team.independent_notice: Each task retains its own run, independent tests and human acceptance. Existing dependencies still require acceptance; queueing is not a promise of simultaneous starts.
expert-team.dispatch_ack: I reviewed every task's fixed responsibility, tool, context and route. I approve starting the entire batch together, with current permissions and limits rechecked by the server.
expert-team.start_all: Confirm and start the complete batch
expert-team.reselect_tasks: Return to tasks and prepare a new selection
expert-team.started_notice: The batch was committed. Follow each original run; completion, tests and acceptance remain separate facts.
expert-team.batch_recovery_hint: The response is unknown. Recover the same original batch operation before another preview or start. Its original versions, acknowledgement and run identities are retained.
expert-team.blocker.invalid: The expert team request is invalid.
expert-team.blocker.changed: The expert configuration changed. Refresh the fixed preview.
expert-team.blocker.inactive: The organization team is not active.
expert-team.blocker.resource: A bound resource or team membership has changed.
expert-team.blocker.binding: A workflow, tool or knowledge binding is no longer eligible.
expert-team.blocker.unpublished: Publish the expert configuration before preparing a batch.
expert-team.blocker.expired: The team dispatch preview has expired.
expert-team.blocker.plan_changed: The team dispatch plan has changed.
expert-team.blocker.owned: This task plan belongs to a team batch and cannot be started separately.
expert-team.blocker.ack: Explicit approval is required before starting the complete batch.
expert-team.blocker.task: A task is already active or its prerequisite tasks have not been accepted.
